payload.instruction: Change the image into pencil drawing
payload.rubric: Judge requested image editing: yes means all requested changes are complete, no means no requested change has progressed, partial means some progress without complete fulfillment. Unrelated edits are not requested progress. Insufficient evidence stays unresolved.

node.question: Has the image been changed into a pencil drawing?
node.criteria: complete: the image as a whole is convincingly rendered as a pencil drawing, with drawing-like linework and tonal shading replacing photographic rendering across the scene. partial: visible pencil-drawing cues, such as sketch-like texture or graphite-like shading, affect some or much of the image, but substantial photographic rendering remains or the drawing treatment is inconsistent. Desaturation, muted color, or grain alone is not sufficient for complete; unrelated edits do not count. absent: no requested pencil-drawing transformation is evident. unknown: evidence is insufficient to determine progress.
node.binding: Target: the image. Reference: pencil drawing.

outcome.description: Transform the image into a pencil drawing.

response.content: {"status":"partial","evidence":"The edited image has muted, mostly desaturated tones and visible grain, but the food and tableware retain substantial photographic detail; convincing pencil-like linework and graphite shading do not extend across the scene.","confidence":0.94}
